poc_plan.title: KYC Document Review Automation
poc_plan.objective: The bank wants to reduce the manual effort involved in reviewing customer onboarding documents and identifying incomplete KYC cases.
in_scope: Automate first-level review of customer KYC documents
Identify missing or inconsistent customer information
Provide explainable recommendations for human reviewers
approach: Reuse the capabilities and integrations from the UK-001 template to automate KYC document review and flag exceptions.
Adapt the IN-001 template to support document classification and field validation for KYC review.
Ensure the solution aligns with the US region and OCC regulator.
success_criteria: Reduce manual first-level KYC review effort
Identify missing or inconsistent customer information
Provide explainable recommendations for human reviewers
proposed_changes: Region: The Brief is in the US, while the templates are for the UK and India.
Regulator: The Brief specifies OCC, while the templates are for FCA and RBI.
